headline: Danantara Targets Completing Mergers and Consolidation of 600 BUMN in 2027
summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara aims to consolidate 600 state-owned enterprises for efficiency gains. About 380 companies have been consolidated so far.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's state investment holding company that manages stakes in state-owned enterprises (BUMN). Its restructuring affects the governance and valuation of a large group of listed and unlisted state companies.
original_headline: Danantara Targetkan 600 BUMN Rampung Merger dan Konsolidasi di 2027
